claim: *Work Over Time.* Epics — DocAble's unit of formalized engineering intent — created and closed per week from the convention's introduction in week 12. A record of intent formalized, not of a backlog drained: creation outpaces closure by roughly three to one. The first week's 111 openings are a formalization event, not a burst of ideation; the trace is invariant to the late-era landing-mechanism change.
topology: Quantitative axes preserve source values and categories.
bw_encoding: Explicit labels, distinct markers and monochrome patterns; no color-only distinction.
redesign: Two vertically aligned panels retain weekly intent and accumulated active estimate. Restored external units and interpretive annotations at 10 pt.
